items.title: Bitcoin hits $80.5K as US stocks rally on midterm election results
items.content: Bitcoin climbed toward $80,500 as risk assets rallied on Democrats’ midterm election gains and oil prices fell.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: France backs reporting for self-custodied crypto worth 100K euros or more
items.content: The amendment would require taxpayers to report holdings worth at least $112,000, but the measure still needs to survive the budget process.

items.title: Canton’s CC rises 4% as SEC staff view it as ‘digital commodity’
items.content: SEC staff’s no-action letter covers CC earned by running infrastructure and applications, but is not a binding ruling on its legal status.

items.title: Binance hack may be ‘temporary setback’ for crypto, Grayscale’s Pandl says
items.content: Zach Pandl highlighted institutional custody safeguards as crypto markets recovered some losses following the record $6.3 billion Binance hack.

items.title: Justin Sun seeks $264K sanctions over World Liberty’s UAE disclosure
items.content: Sun plans to refile his token-freeze lawsuit in California state court after the sanctions motion is resolved. A hearing is set for Dec. 10.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.16B as Bitwise calls selling ‘short-term’
items.content: Bitwise’s André Dragosch attributed Bitcoin ETF outflows to weaker market sentiment, saying institutions have largely maintained their exposure.

items.title: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress
items.content: Democrats won control of Congress in the 2026 US midterms. Catch up on key races, crypto-backed candidates and the outlook for crypto regulation.

items.title: Binance hackers move 81% of stolen Solana, route funds via THORChain
items.content: The Binance attackers moved most of the stolen SOL and continued laundering funds through THORChain after the protocol resumed swaps.

items.title: Democrats win US House to secure control of Congress in midterms
items.content: Democrats will take control of House committees in January 2027, giving them power to investigate President Donald Trump’s administration.

items.title: Bitcoin bounces from 7-week low under $76K as Democrats sweep Congress
items.content: Bitcoin price downside reached a seven-week-low of $75,618 as 24-hour crypto long liquidations neared $300 million.

items.title: Ethereum dev targets 2028 for quantum resistance, a year early
items.content: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake said it is their “hope” that Ethereum will achieve its post-quantum and post-AI transition by December 2028.

items.title: Democrats claim control of the US Senate
items.content: The shift in Senate control could change the path for the CLARITY Act, reshape committee leadership and bring closer scrutiny of Trump’s crypto businesses.

items.title: ZachXBT identifies French bank as alleged victim of $133M crypto theft
items.content: The French bank has not confirmed its alleged involvement in the crypto theft, which ZachXBT said could have resulted in losses exceeding $133 million.

items.title: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold
items.content: Crypto executives expect US regulators to drive crypto policymaking regardless of the midterm election outcome.

items.title: RUNE rallies 15% as THORChain restarts most swaps after halt
items.content: THORChain has restored trading on Bitcoin, Ethereum and several other networks following a refund bug, while three chains remain paused.

items.title: SpaceX blocks tokenized stock listing on OKXICE despite offshore trading boom
items.content: SpaceX joined several other issuers objecting to OKXICE tokenized trading, months after crypto platforms offered tokens tied to its shares.

items.title: CFTC clears stock perpetual futures for trading on US exchanges
items.content: US regulators are opening the door to stock-based perpetual futures, extending a popular crypto trading product into traditional markets amid ongoing legal disputes.

items.title: US midterms: Prediction markets favor Democrats in key crypto races
items.content: Kalshi and Polymarket price a 75% chance of a Democratic sweep, days after markets misjudged Brazil’s runoff.

items.title: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen
items.content: Markus Thielen sees Bitcoin reaching $90,000 by year-end, questions institutional ETF demand and says Ethereum must do more for holders.

items.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
items.content: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to the exchange’s investigation.

items.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’
items.content: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.

items.title: What’s at stake for crypto as the US votes in the 2026 midterms?
items.content: Crypto groups spent about $176 million ahead of the US midterms, with control of Congress and the future of crypto legislation at stake.

items.title: Moscow Exchange to launch Bitcoin, Ether and USDT trading in December
items.content: Moscow Exchange plans to launch crypto trading on Dec. 1 under Russia’s new law, with annual purchase limits for non-qualified investors.

items.title: NEAR token sinks 7% as proposal to cut annual token issuance passes
items.content: The proposed issuance cut would prevent 11.8 million NEAR from entering circulation over two years, worth about $45 million at today’s price.

items.title: Binance’s net inflows turn positive at $2.3B as withdrawals expand
items.content: Binance led exchanges in 24-hour net inflows, reversing Monday’s heavy outflows as it restored access to funds after its $6.3 billion hack.

items.title: France postpones 2027 budget vote, crypto exit-tax proposals scrapped
items.content: The National Assembly postponed the vote on the budget’s revenue section for the second time, while the Nov. 17 deadline for the first reading examination nears.

items.title: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater
items.content: Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort in a move that risked flipping it to new resistance.

items.title: ARK buys $17M in Coinbase, Circle shares while trimming Bullish
items.content: ARK Invest added Coinbase and Circle shares across two trading sessions while selling about $8 million in Bullish as crypto stocks declined.

items.title: Kraken restricts accounts linked to suspected $133M EU crypto theft
items.content: Crypto.com also took steps to block funds tied to the suspected theft, while Kraken said its systems and customer accounts were not compromised.
